column1: # Raw bytes are the decoded command bytes the emulated PM IR FIFO hands to the original firmware (logical IR_KEY 3DA9).
# A function without an entry cannot be delivered (no invented codes). Fill in only evidence-backed values; see docs/ir-input-path.md.
# Digits: raw 0x01..0x09 -> app codes 0x11..0x19, raw 0x45 -> app 0x10 (docs/ir-raw-to-app-key-table.tsv); the original handler 8046DA24..8046DB2C computes value*10+(app-0x10).

column3: app 0x11 = digit 1 (8046DA24 numeric entry; run s15: raw 1 -> app 0x11 -> OSD 17 digit banner)
app 0x10 = digit 0 (static: table 0x8061773C, raw 0x45; not yet exercised in a connected run)
